videos.script:
I got tired of football games where weather is basically just decoration.
So I made it actually affect the gameplay.
In Fourth & Glory, rain makes catching the football harder.
Wind affects passing accuracy.
And snow can make it harder for players to move around the field.
The best part?
Bad weather also means better rewards.
So when you see a snowstorm on the event map, you've got a decision to make.
Avoid the risk?
Or take on a harder game for a bigger reward?
Personally, I'm taking the snow game.

youtube.title: I Made Weather Actually Matter in My Football Game ❄️ #shorts
youtube.text:
I got tired of football games where weather is just decoration, so I made it actually matter. ❄️🌧️

In Fourth & Glory, rain makes the ball harder to catch. Wind throws off passing accuracy. Snow makes it harder for players to move around the field.

The best part? Bad weather also means better rewards. So when you see a snowstorm on the event map, you've got a decision to make: avoid the risk, or take the harder game for a bigger payoff?

Personally, I'm taking the snow game. What about you? 👇

Fourth & Glory is a football deckbuilder I'm building as an indie dev. Subscribe to follow the journey! 🏈

videos.script:
What if the more you used your favorite football play, the better it became?
That's exactly how mastery works in Fourth & Glory.
Every time you gain yards, convert a first down, or score with a play, it earns experience.
Earn enough XP, and you get to choose one of three upgrades.
You can upgrade a play up to three times during a run.
And bonus cards have their own mastery system too.
So that basic play you started with?
By the time you reach the championship, it could become one of the best weapons in your entire deck.
